name: gap-frame
description: The gap frame on the wire (decision 5.14: a flagged empty frame, not an out-of-band message; immortality §4.3: truth over pretense). The core had committed output 1 and 2 when no core peer held the session's data socket; the target kept printing, and the ring dropped the oldest frames, 3 to 6. The handshake's hello_ack said first_buffered_seq 7 and last_dropped_ts the stamp of frame 6, so the replay writes, before its first frame, an output frame with flags bit 1 set and no payload: seq 6 — first_buffered_seq - 1, the last lost seq, never a surviving frame's — and that stamp. The jump from 2 lands on it, and the next frame is 7. The recording holds a gap marker in its place (C8 gap-marker). Captures of a forced overflow must show the same.
